description: Held-out-family screen for the frozen auto planner. Both families were added after the planner, its analysis budget and the v1/v2 screens were fixed; neither was used to tune any cost constant. Frozen before any timing of these families.
validation: matrix-free NumPy statevector oracle, absolute tolerance 1e-10

analysis_plan.lifetime: L_m(R) = setup_m + R * median collection_m over all sessions; setup is planning for LazyQC plans and Qulacs circuit construction for direct
analysis_plan.selection_regret: L_auto(R) / min over full, separate, grouped of L_m(R), per circuit instance
analysis_plan.cross_validated_regret: pick the forced plan with least lifetime on one session, evaluate auto against that pick on the other session; average both directions

strata.cone_ratio: grouped_max_width / qubits from the planned grouped candidate, computed before timing

analysis_plan.intervals: percentile bootstrap of the per-instance median ratio, resampling circuit instances, 10000 draws, 95%

criteria.C1_direct_improvement: in the narrow and high-overlap stratum, median direct_ratio at R=1 <= 0.90 with the upper 95% bound below 1
criteria.C2_selection_regret: median cross-validated selection regret at R=1 <= 1.10 over all held-out instances
criteria.C3_saturation_guard: in the saturated stratum, median direct_ratio at R=1 <= 1.10
criteria.tails: report the 90th percentile and maximum of selection regret and direct_ratio, and every failure

analysis_plan.decision_information: auto uses only the request batch and its static cost model; no timing from this screen informs any plan choice
